thought.text: RabbitMQ 3.9.27 installed (with Erlang). Now MapServer. Let me check apt availability:

reasoning_content:
RabbitMQ 3.9.27 is installed. The publiccode.yml says 4.0–4.3 is required, but DNS can't reach the RabbitMQ package host. The guide doesn't specify a version. 3.9.27 is installed and functional. Quorum queues exist in 3.9 as well. Let's proceed — I'll make a note about this point.

Next, I'll set up MapServer.

action.command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive; apt-cache policy mapserver 2>/dev/null | head -4; apt-cache policy libmapserver-dev 2>/dev/null | head -3

tool_call.name: terminal
